description.value:
Certain weaponskills open a follow-up gunshot. After using a qualifying action you may spend 1 action to fire the linked follow-up before your turn ends:

  • @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.bf44b0d50715c762]{Gnashing Fang} → @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.84d4d65427e30457]{Jugular Rip}
  • @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.c92a9a4f65aed576]{Savage Claw} → @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.d2e7e82195b0d940]{Abdomen Tear}
  • @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.901295e96cdc5cc2]{Wicked Talon} → @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.46135863d5cb73ef]{Eye Gouge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.148481d3f7d0f02b]{Burst Strike} → @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.291e00009610fbc7]{Hypervelocity}
  • @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.2d1c8118880acda4]{Fated Circle} → @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.11009f00b5d265be]{Fated Brand}

You gain the relevant follow-up actions automatically as you unlock their parent actions through @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.8167449ad5822303]{Advanced Cartridge Arts}.
